text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph on pure white seamless background with soft neutral studio light. Entire items visible, realistic material texture, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin, hanger or stand, no text or watermark. One soft black flat-top cadet cap with shallow cylindrical crown, horizontal stitched band and curved short visor with tonal parallel stitching. Washed matte cotton fabric. Three-quarter front view.
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one high-resolution portrait 2:3 photographic wardrobe asset for Vicky wardrobe library, pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio lighting, realistic materials, all objects fully inside frame with generous margins. References 1 and 2 show the SAME outfit, use both for details. Remove ALL person, hair, skin, body, mannequin, hanger, stand, outdoor background. No text, labels, collage borders or watermark. Faithfully reconstruct visible item details; conservatively complete occluded structure. Show ONLY ONE black flat-top cadet/military-style cap from the photos. Soft shallow cylindrical crown, horizontal band with tonal stitching, gently curved short visor with parallel stitched contours, slightly washed matte black cotton/velvety fabric. Three-quarter front product view, empty hollow cap, no head or hair, centered and large. No other items.
reproduction_note: 依据用户两张参考照片制作白底无人商品图；被头发和靴子遮挡的服装区域保守补全。保留可见版型、纹理与配饰，不作为品牌或精确款号鉴定。
